versions.note: from tools/music_round5.py (written for Lyria 3 Pro); its length sentence dropped, since Lyria 2 makes about 33 s
versions.prompt: Light solo piano with a soft warm synth pad underneath, a simple quiet melody with space between the notes, like a calm menu screen. 76 BPM. Relaxed everyday background music for a slice-of-life video game, instrumental only, no vocals. Sparse, unhurried and easy to listen to for a long time. No strings section, no orchestra, nothing epic or dramatic, no big build-up or climax. No ending: it keeps the same calm level to the end so it can loop.

versions.note: Round 6 feedback (title-1: start not great, too repetitive, too fast): slower, a gentle start with no hit, melody that changes phrase to phrase
versions.prompt: Slow, gentle solo piano with a soft warm pad and a little music-box, 62 BPM. A tender melody that keeps developing: each phrase differs from the last, with new notes and a different ending, never one motif repeated. It begins softly and already in motion, with no sharp opening note, and stays at one calm level. Relaxed everyday background music for a slice-of-life video game, instrumental only, no vocals. No strings section, no orchestra, nothing epic or dramatic, no big build-up or climax. No ending: it keeps the same calm level to the end so it can loop.

versions.note: Round 7 feedback (all three takes "funeral"): bright and hopeful in a major key at a medium tempo, a light band instead of slow solo piano; the "no" words moved to the negative prompt, so the prompt names only what is heard.
versions.prompt: Bright, hopeful slice-of-life anime title theme in a major key, 96 BPM: warm piano and clean electric guitar playing a clear, friendly melody, with soft bass and light pop drums. Cheerful and fresh, like a sunny morning on a small island where everyone works at the same company. Easygoing, not rushed. Instrumental background music for a video game menu. It stays at one level all the way through, with no ending, so it can loop.

settings.negative_prompt: sad, melancholic, mournful, funeral, sombre, slow, dirge, minor key, solo piano ballad, vocals, singing, orchestra, epic, dramatic
